Subject: Forecast clearance & owner rotations — EMEA/APAC rollup

Team —

Quick alignment note as finance asks for a tightened rollup: we need a clean owner list and stage confirmation for all EMEA/APAC opportunities > $50k by EOD Monday 15 Mar (EMEA close of business). Please do the following:

- Owners: confirm the named AE/SE on each active opportunity in the attached snapshot. If the owner has changed in the last 14 days, mark the row and add short rationale.
- Stage hygiene: move any opportunities with no contact in 30+ days out of Commit; mark them as 'Needs Outreach' or 'At Risk'.
- Commit clearance: only opportunities with verified PO or signed SOW should remain in Commit. Finance needs the list locked for forecasting on Tuesday.

I've attached the EMEA_APAC_pipeline_snapshot_Q2.xlsx with my initial pass — I highlighted rows I think need owner rotations. Also attaching a simple owner_rotation_matrix template for you to use.

Thanks — small, fast changes here will make the forecast stick and avoid manual asks from FP&A.

Soojin
Director, EMEA Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
